title: Okta buys AI security startup Permiso; source says for about $200M
slides: Did Okta just bet its future on Permiso's tech?
Permiso spots identity threats no one else sees.
Okta paid nearly $200M—its largest security deal yet.
Your Okta logs may now catch attacks in real time.
Ask your security team if Permiso is already onboard.
thread_text:
Okta's $200M bet.

Permiso's tech now runs inside Okta's identity fabric. Every login you've logged just became a data point in a real-time threat hunt.

They see what logs miss.

Permiso spots machine identity abuse, session hijacking, and priv esc that standard monitoring tools ignore. Okta bought that detection engine.

Your logs just got smarter.

Existing Okta customers get the upgrade without a new deployment. The same logs you already ship now feed Permiso's anomaly detection.

Real-time, not retro.

Most identity attacks are caught hours later. Permiso flags them mid-session. That's the difference between a block and a breach.

Ask your security team today.

Is Permiso already active in your Okta tenant? If not, what's the rollout timeline? Push for an answer this week.
